Non-RTO options
Checked options are paid upfront (added to Cost Reduction) — not financed in RTO. Default: all unchecked (all options RTO-eligible).
RTO monthly divisors
The calculator uses: pre‑tax monthly = RTO amount ÷ divisor for the selected term (36 / 48 / 60 mo), where RTO amount = building subtotal (with assurance if RTO) minus pre‑tax cost reduction. Tax is added on the payment. Down payments still follow the built‑in width table (RTO_DOWN). Defaults match the previous app: 19.8 / 22.56 / 27.

Edit the JSON array of code, name, and img (image URL or data URL). Saved only on this device via Save style data — not included when you tap Done on main settings.

LINKS & CLOUD
Links & Integrations
CRM Integration
Off
Firebase (Firestore only)
Firestore sync is active. Firebase Storage is optional and not required.
The app signs in when it opens and keeps this browser signed in. Leave both blank to use Anonymous auth (enable it in Firebase Console → Authentication) if you prefer not to store a password here.
Google Drive Photo Upload
If configured, inventory photos upload to Google Drive and links are stored in Firestore.
Cloudflare R2 photo upload (optional)
If set, inventory photos use this Worker first (multipart JPEG + thumbnail). Deploy the Worker in inv-r2-upload-worker, create the R2 bucket, run wrangler secret put UPLOAD_TOKEN, then paste the deploy URL ending in /upload. JPEG is the canonical format for shareable URLs. Falls back to Google Drive when R2 is not configured.

Home quick tools
